pricePolicy: Prices are snapshots read from the seller's own product page on the date shown. They are not a live feed or a promise that the price, size, or inventory is unchanged. Reopen the source before purchase.
goldValuePolicy: No ring has a verified gold-only weight, and no current gold quote has been imported. Gold-content and melt-value outputs are not prefilled or estimated.
